comparison.objective: Cut a taped carton seam safely and retract the blade; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool grasp, depth-controlled linear cutting, and blade retraction versus dual-blade insertion, tang depression, and coordinated extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Complete seam cut without product/cardboard damage and blade retracted versus correct terminal removed without connector damage.
comparison.reason: Tool use and damage avoidance are generic; the contact mechanics and tested abilities differ.
